lines.en: I have no feet; I can't walk.
My roots are in the soil; moving would break them.
All I can do is turn my head.
When the wind comes, I sway with it.

lines.zh: 我的茎很细，撑不住太多
lines.en: My stem is thin and can't hold much.

lines.zh: 土里有东西在动，不是我
lines.en: Something moves in the soil, and it isn't me.
I lean toward the light.
In a whole day I shifted one inch.
To move me, dig up the soil with me.

lines.zh: 我在这块地上扎得挺深
lines.en: I've rooted deep in this patch.

lines.zh: 花瓣掉了一片，我还在原地
lines.en: A petal fell, and I'm still here.
I don't leave; whoever comes, it's the same.
I'm open, perfectly still.
My face turns to the sun.
I'm drawing on the ground's breath here.
Someone's near, and I don't move.
The edge of my petals has curled.
My roots spread wide below.
A bug crawls up my stem.
I've been open a long time.
It's only a posture.

lines.zh: 我在等，等什么我也不知道
lines.en: I'm waiting, though I don't know for what.
At night I close up.
My shadow is short on the ground.
This bloom is larger than the others.
I can reach the water in the soil.
The grass beside me has grown tall.

lines.zh: 谁把我从枝上摘下来过
lines.en: Someone once picked me from a stem.
I watch, though I can't turn away.

lines.zh: 落下来的东西都落在我的花盘上
lines.en: Things that fall land in my bloom.
You're looking down at a flower.

lines.zh: 我不动，你别以为我死了
lines.en: I'm still; don't think I'm dead.
I'm not an ordinary flower.
Are you going to pick me?

lines.zh: 我能感觉你踩在地上的震
lines.en: I feel your footsteps in the ground.
The thorns are on my stem.

lines.zh: 我一直对着光，不对着你
lines.en: I face the light, not you.
Crouch down and you'll see better.
You don't have to speak.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，可我看着你
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I watch you.

lines.zh: 你用手指碰我的花瓣，我不躲
lines.en: Touch my petals; I won't flinch.
A petal came off.
My stem bent.
I don't cry out; flowers don't.
My roots felt the shock.
That loosened the soil.
Sap runs from the break.
I'm bent and can't straighten.
Hit again and the stem breaks.
I'll wait for it to grow back.

lines.zh: 你把水举起来，我要的是土里的
lines.en: You raise water; I want what's in the soil.
Give me light and I'll pay attention.
I don't take nectar or eat bugs.
Loose soil would help me.
Set it by my roots.
Keep it.

lines.zh: 你举着东西靠近，我没有腿。
lines.en: You hold something out, and I have no legs.

lines.zh: 引诱一朵不会动的花，很容易。
lines.en: Tempting a flower that cannot move is easy.
You hit my stem.
I don't dodge, and I can't.
You knocked off two petals.
My roots were loosened by your step.
That bent me over.
Step back and I can straighten.
Your foot is right by my roots.
I swayed, unbroken.
Don't step again.
I'm a flower, and my season is short.
There's another blooming nearby.
The wind carries the pollen over.
We won't walk to each other.
This flower's spot was chosen.

lines.zh: 落下来的种子不归我管
lines.en: The seeds that fall aren't mine to mind.
Do you see that one over there?
We hand our pollen to the wind.
Don't pick; picking ends it.
Quiet, the wind is here.
I have no hands.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西都落在我脚下
lines.en: What falls lands at my feet.
I draw through roots, not pick up.
This is weighing on my petals.
There's one on the ground.
I can't lift it.

lines.zh: 这些东西会烂在我的根边
lines.en: These will rot by my roots.

lines.zh: 花瓣一张一合，地上的东西与我无关。
lines.en: My petals open and close; the ground's gifts concern me not.
Take it if you like.
It's blocking my light.
A shadow falls on me.
I feel footsteps.
This flower's thorns aren't decor.
I face the light, not you.
My reach is only this much.

lines.zh: 扎根原地，谁来我都张开花瓣。
lines.en: Rooted here, I open my petals for whoever comes.
You've come to my side.
The distance is just right.
Right in front of my bloom.
You're still by my roots.
My stem turns slowly.
No rush; I'm rooted.
My petals are drawn tight.
I know this ground.
This height is just right.
Now.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，虽然我一步也走不了。
lines.en: I see you, though I can't take a single step.
The whole bloom whips across.
My stem snaps out and hits you.

lines.zh: 我的刺划开了你的袖子
lines.en: My thorns tore your sleeve.
Even my petal edges are hard.
I can only swing once.
You're struck back two steps.
I sway back and hit again.
My bloom strikes your chest.
My roots were pulled loose.

lines.zh: 这一下之后，我动不了了
lines.en: After that, I can't move.
A stem rises from the soil.
I bloomed on this patch.
I didn't grow naturally.
Light fell, and I opened.

lines.zh: 我的根一落地就抓住土
lines.en: The moment my roots touched, they gripped.
This bloom came out large.
I turn toward the sun.
The soil is fresh, not yet packed.
I'm open, and I can't move.
Someone's standing by, watching me.

lines.zh: 这朵花在别处开过，现在在这儿
lines.en: This flower bloomed elsewhere; now it's here.
My petals open one by one.
Fire curled my petals first.
I was driven a little into the soil.
Water over my roots is stifling.
The blast scattered every petal.

lines.zh: 一根东西穿过我的花盘
lines.en: Something went through my bloom.

lines.zh: 法术打来，我整朵亮了一下
lines.en: The spell hit and my whole bloom flashed.

lines.zh: 没有光，我就慢慢合起来
lines.en: Without light, I slowly close.

lines.zh: 雷落在我旁边，土都焦了
lines.en: Lightning struck beside me and scorched the soil.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我抓不住
lines.en: No soil in the void; nothing to grip.
